title: Product of Array Except Self
statement:
Given an integer array nums, return an array output where output[i] is equal to the product of all elements of nums except nums[i].

You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time and without using the division operation.
constraints: The product of any prefix or suffix of nums is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit integer

visibleExamples.explanation: output[2] = (-1)*1*(-3)*3 = 9; all other indices involve a zero product
